pages.text: Many blocks are crafted from eight NOOP blocks around one item. You get eight blocks:
$(li)COMMENT: glass$(li)LITERAL: white wool$(li)OPERATOR: red wool$(li)ASSIGN: cyan wool$(li)TAG: brown wool$(li)BEGIN: yellow wool$(li)EXIT: iron door$(li)PARAMETER: hopper$(li)RETURN: spruce door
The $(l)type base$() (red carpet) and the $(l)structural base$() (green wool) are made the same way. They are items for crafting other blocks.
